_readme: Sample-pack roots for the Beat Machine. Add a folder path to "roots" (or drop new packs inside an existing root) and the next launch picks it up.
One-shots only: loops, MIDI, presets, and instrument folders (bass/melodic/keys/vocals) are skipped automatically.

sorted_root: the ONE folder you sort yourself. In there the FOLDER NAME says what a sample is and what it is like (Kicks/Hard), so file names stop mattering. Everywhere else taste words are read from the file name exactly as before, so nothing you have already approved can change. See its READ ME.

instrument_sorted_root / instrument_roots: the melodic-instrument twin of sorted_root/roots above, kept in separate keys on purpose so switching the drum sample source never touches the instrument pool (and vice versa). See BOTC Sorted Instruments/READ ME.txt.

strings_sections / strings_styles: which London Symphonic Strings the DJs can play (owner 2026-09-14). Sections: violin, viola, cello, basses. Styles: sustain (held), pizz (plucked), short (spiccato/marcato), tremolo. Remove a word to leave it out; the files stay where they are.

loop_roots / loop_sorted_root: the melodic-LOOP twin of instrument_roots/instrument_sorted_root above, kept in its own keys for the same reason -- so switching the drum or instrument source never starves loop_voice (tools/melodic_loops.py) again. Points at his real loop pack folders plus BOTC Sorted Loops; see its READ ME.txt.
